_meta.source: 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix (Wikipedia: Indian Administrative Service, Indian Police Service, Higher Judicial Service); state DA/establishment ratios are approximate.
_meta.caveat: Salary is a PER-POST role attribute, never per-person. Figures are the pay-matrix BASIC range. 'cost_to_govt' multiplies basic by est_cost_multiplier to approximate full cost-to-government (DA, HRA, pension liability, vehicle, staff, office). Multiplier is an editorial estimate (~2.2x basic) consistent with this project's ±10% approximation convention. Use as directional, not auditable to the rupee.

District Collector.note: Selection grade / Junior Administrative+ . Also District Magistrate.

Superintendent of Police.note: District SP. Senior districts headed by an SSP (Level 13A).

Commissioner of Police.note: Heads a city Police Commissionerate (e.g. Kolkata, Mumbai). Holds magisterial powers a DM would elsewhere; senior to a district SP.

District & Sessions Judge.note: Higher Judicial Service pay (2nd National Judicial Pay Commission scale).

Sub-Divisional Magistrate.note: SDM / Sub-Collector. Junior time scale entry.

Block Development Officer.note: BDO — development side at block level (runs MGNREGS, PMAY-G, panchayat schemes). State civil service, NOT IAS. The lowest rung that directly disburses central-scheme money.

Tehsildar.note: Tahsildar — revenue side at tehsil/taluk level (land records, revenue collection, relief). State civil service, NOT IAS.

Chief Secretary.note: Apex scale, fixed. State's senior-most civil servant.

Director General of Police.note: State police head, fixed apex scale.

Governor.note: Salary fixed by Governors (Emoluments) Act; plus Raj Bhavan establishment (much larger).

Lieutenant Governor.note: UT constitutional head; pay on par with Governor.

Administrator.note: UT-without-legislature head; often a Governor of an adjacent state holding additional charge (then no extra salary).

Chief Minister.note: Varies widely by state (salary + constituency + sumptuary allowances). Wide range is real, not error.

District-in-charge Minister.note: A state cabinet minister also assigned a district portfolio; cost counted at state level, not additive per district.

Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha).note: ₹1L salary + constituency/office/secretarial allowances + travel; full cost well above basic.

Member of Parliament (Rajya Sabha).note: Same emolument structure as Lok Sabha members.

Member of Legislative Assembly.note: Salary + allowances vary sharply by state; range reflects that, not uncertainty.
